implementation: Microsoft Windows 10 November 2015 Update; Microsoft Surface Book, Surface Pro 4, Surface Pro 3, Surface 3, Surface Pro 2, and Surface Pro w/ Windows 10 November 2015 Update; Windows 10 Mobile for Microsoft Lumia 950 and Microsoft Lumia 635; Windows 10 for Microsoft Surface Hub 84” and Surface Hub 55” Cryptography Next Generation (CNG) Implementations
description: The Microsoft Windows Kernel Mode Cryptographic Primitives Library -- Cryptography Next Generation (CNG) -- is a general purpose, software-based, cryptographic module which provides FIPS 140-2 Level 1 cryptography.
